11.transport: 07:30 NYC departure → Scranton 10:00–10:30 → Ithaca about 13:00–13:30. Allow 5–5.5h driving + 30min stop (5.5–6h total).

activities.text: Collect rental car and leave NYC.
Scranton Downtown: warm snack and Courthouse Square walk.
Arrive Cornell; quick lunch, park and check in.

12.transport: 06:45 Ithaca departure → Oneonta 08:45–09:15 → Brattleboro 11:45–12:15 → Hanover about 13:45. Allow about 6h driving + 1h breaks (7h total; winter traffic may add time).

activities.text: Leave Ithaca; carry breakfast / snacks.
Oneonta Main Street: bakery / café breakfast stop.
Brattleboro Downtown: warm lunch.
Arrive Hanover and check in for the campus visit.
Target Dartmouth information session and guided tour; afternoon slot essential.
Alumni chat if arranged; dinner and hotel.

10.transport: Hotel → Battery Park by subway/taxi 35–50min. Reserve a target 10:00 security-entry slot for Statue City Cruises; allow until 13:30 for security, ferries, Liberty Island grounds and museum. NYC walking/subway legs 10–40min. Ferry schedule and winter service must be confirmed.

activities.text: Leave hotel for Castle Clinton / Battery Park ferry security area.

Statue of Liberty: target timed security entry, then ferry to Liberty Island, grounds and Statue of Liberty Museum. Return to Manhattan without an Ellis Island museum visit. The ticket time is security entry, not a guaranteed boat departure.
Carry a substantial snack / light lunch for the island; warm Chinatown lunch follows after returning.
Walk from The Battery to Wall Street / Charging Bull, then the 9/11 Memorial outdoor plaza.
Chinatown: warm rice / noodles lunch; browse Mott Street and Canal Street.
SoHo: Broadway and nearby cast-iron streets / shops.
Brooklyn Bridge: short walk from the Manhattan entrance and skyline photographs; return to the Manhattan side.
Greenwich Village / Washington Square Park and an outdoor NYU campus-area stroll.
Dinner in Greenwich Village; return to the hotel and pack.
